model_annotation: This donut chart displays the distribution of data across two categories, Ambiguity Std (Outer) and Max Ambiguity (Inner), with each category represented by a distinct ring of segments. The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)", is composed of four segments corresponding to standard deviation values of 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, which are represented by dark blue, medium blue, light blue, and very light blue, respectively. The percentages for these segments are 49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%. The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)", consists of three segments for maximum ambiguity values of 1, 2, and 3, shown in light blue, very light blue, and pale blue. The percentages for these are 38.0%, 14.2%, and 39.0%. The chart includes a legend on the right side that matches the colors to their respective labels and values. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order around the donut, with the largest segment in the outer ring being the one for Std: 0.0 (49.0%) and the largest in the inner ring being Max: 3 (39.0%).
